channel.title: Scout Daily — AI Intelligence Feed

item.title: [News] Introducing Advanced Account Security
item.description: OpenAI is introducing Advanced Account Security to prevent account takeover and safeguard sensitive data with phishing-resistant login, stronger recovery, and enhanced protections.

item.title: [News] Where the goblins came from
item.description: OpenAI discusses the spread of 'goblin' outputs in GPT-5 AI models and the root cause behind their appearance.

item.title: [News] Building the compute infrastructure for the Intelligence Age
item.description: OpenAI expands Stargate to build AI compute infrastructure, adding new data centers to meet growing demand.

item.title: [News] Unlocking human ambition to drive business growth with AI
item.description: Microsoft is helping customers unlock human ambition with AI to drive business growth by optimizing work processes and reinventing businesses.

item.title: [News] Microsoft Sovereign Private Cloud scales to thousands of nodes with Azure Local
item.description: Microsoft's Azure Local now supports deployments of up to thousands of servers in a single sovereign environment, allowing for larger local workloads. This is ideal for datacenters, industrial environments, and edge locations.
